title: Observations vs Insights
hints: BLUF puts the main answer first.
explanation: Insights connect observations to decisions, and BLUF leads with the conclusion.

questions.question: Which statement is an actionable insight rather than just a raw observation?
options: The dataset has 1,240 rows and 6 columns.
Cart abandonment spikes on mobile checkout Step 2; simplifying the address form could recover lost orders.
questions.explanation: It pairs an observation with a specific cause/impact and a concrete recommendation.

title: BLUF structure
prompt: Recall what BLUF stands for in memos.
solution: Bottom Line Up Front: state the main finding and recommendation first.
front: What does BLUF mean when writing an analytics findings memo?
back: **Bottom Line Up Front**: state the main conclusion and recommendation in the opening paragraph before supporting details.

title: Observation vs Insight
hints: What happened vs so what / what next
solution: Observation states what the metric is; insight explains why it matters and what action follows.
front: How does an observation differ from an insight?
back: An **observation** states what the data shows; an **insight** explains why it matters and what decision or action it informs.
